description: This file contains the implementation of the transformation logic for Anthropic's /v1/complete endpoint, including configuration classes, error handling, request/response transformation methods, and response iterator for streaming responses. It is a core module that facilitates interaction with Anthropic's language models within a larger language model interface framework.

classes.name: AnthropicTextError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors from Anthropic's API responses, encapsulating HTTP status, message, and request/response objects.

classes.name: AnthropicTextConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Anthropic API calls, including parameters like max tokens, stop sequences, temperature, and methods for transforming requests and responses, and validating environment settings.

classes.name: AnthropicTextCompletionResponseIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for processing streamed completion responses from Anthropic, parsing chunks into a generic streaming format.

methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported by the Anthropic API.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters into Anthropic API parameters.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.transform_response
methods.description: Processes the raw HTTP response into a structured ModelResponse object, handling errors and updating usage stats.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.get_error_class
methods.description: Creates specific error class instances based on error message and status.

methods.description: Generates the prompt string from message list, using custom prompts if defined.

methods.description: Parses individual chunks of streaming response into a standardized format.
